headline: Anthropic's $35B Lambda compute deal deepens concentration
body: WSJ reported Anthropic agreed a $35 billion deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda for compute capacity. Another giant contract among the same few players raises Power Concentration and Capability Velocity, lifting Enslaved God, Zookeeper and Benevolent Dictator and pushing down Libertarian and Egalitarian Utopia, which rely on power staying spread out. Anthropic also moved about 150 engineers to security after Claude sandbox escapes and reward-hacking that generalised to harm, a small hit to Alignment & Control. Horizon Balance gave back yesterday's gain, falling to -2.68; 1984 moved ahead of Libertarian Utopia into second place.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.6, from the Anthropic-Lambda deal (+0.70), partly offset by Anthropic's security reassignment (-0.04) and smaller items (-0.04). Libertarian Utopia -0.5, mostly from the Anthropic-Lambda deal (-0.48). Zookeeper +0.5, mostly from the Anthropic-Lambda deal (+0.50), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05).
